title: Unit 2: Hard Times: Past Simple & Past Continuous
objective: Mampu menceritakan peristiwa masa lampau dengan menggunakan Past Simple dan Past Continuous secara tepat, serta memahami penggunaan 'would' dan 'used to' untuk menyatakan kebiasaan di masa lalu.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara menceritakan peristiwa di masa lampau menggunakan narrative tenses (Past Simple, Past Continuous, Past Perfect, dan Past Perfect Continuous). Kamu juga akan belajar menggunakan 'would' dan 'used to' untuk menggambarkan kebiasaan atau keadaan yang dulu rutin terjadi namun sekarang tidak lagi.
rules: Past Simple: untuk aksi yang selesai di masa lampau. Contoh: 'The fire started in a bakery.'
Past Continuous: untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung di masa lampau, sering terganggu oleh aksi lain. Contoh: 'Thomas Farmer was making bread when a fire broke out.'
Past Perfect: untuk aksi yang terjadi sebelum aksi lain di masa lampau. Contoh: 'It hadn't rained for months.'
Past Perfect Continuous: untuk aksi yang berlangsung lama sebelum waktu tertentu di masa lampau. Contoh: 'The fire had been raging for almost four days.'
Used to + infinitive: untuk kebiasaan atau keadaan di masa lampau (bisa dengan action verb atau stative verb). Contoh: 'Women used to have seven or eight children.'
Would + infinitive: untuk kebiasaan di masa lampau (hanya dengan action verb). Contoh: 'Children would play with teddy bears.'

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula menggunakan 'would' untuk semua jenis kebiasaan masa lampau, padahal 'would' hanya bisa dipakai untuk action verbs. Stative verbs (seperti 'be', 'have', 'know') harus menggunakan 'used to'.
commonTrap.wrong: I would be shy when I was young.
commonTrap.correct: I used to be shy when I was young.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara Ian dan Oli tentang pengalaman menakutkan Ian kemarin ketika melihat asap dari jendela rumahnya

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.text: I had a real scare yesterday. As I was walking up to our house, I saw smoke coming from the window.
lines.translation: Aku sangat ketakutan kemarin. Saat aku sedang berjalan menuju rumah, aku melihat asap keluar dari jendela.

lines.speaker: Oli
lines.translation: Oh tidak! Apakah ada yang terbakar?

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.text: Fortunately not. I ran into the house, opened the kitchen door and there was my brother. He was doing science experiments! One of them went wrong and exploded.
lines.translation: Untungnya tidak. Aku berlari masuk ke rumah, membuka pintu dapur dan di sana ada kakakku. Dia sedang melakukan eksperimen sains! Salah satunya gagal dan meledak.

lines.speaker: Oli
lines.text: That must have been terrifying at first!

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan dengan tutor tentang pengalaman masa kecil dan kebiasaan di masa lampau

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today let's talk about your childhood. What kinds of games did you use to play when you were younger?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: When I was a child, I used to play traditional games with my friends in the neighborhood.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That sounds lovely! Can you tell me more? What would you and your friends do after school?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: After school, we would meet at the park and play hide-and-seek or fly kites together until sunset.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Wonderful memories! Did you use to have any pets when you were growing up?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I used to have a cat. I would feed it every morning before going to school.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent use of 'used to' and 'would'! Tell me, what was family life like in your house back then?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My parents used to be very strict. We would eat dinner together every evening, and they would always ask about our day at school.

quiz.question: While people ____ towards the river, a warehouse ____ and blocked their escape.
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous ('were running') menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung, kemudian Past Simple ('exploded') untuk aksi yang tiba-tiba terjadi dan menginterupsi.

quiz.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: I would have a cat when I was young.
I used to have a cat when I was young.
I would to have a cat when I was young.
quiz.answer: I used to have a cat when I was young.
quiz.explanation: 'Have' adalah stative verb, jadi harus menggunakan 'used to', bukan 'would'.

quiz.question: The fire ____ for months before it finally started in September 1666.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect ('hadn't rained') digunakan untuk menunjukkan kondisi yang terjadi sebelum peristiwa di masa lampau (kebakaran).

quiz.question: Children ____ play with teddy bears in the 1950s. These days, many children have electronic games.
quiz.explanation: 'Would' digunakan untuk kebiasaan di masa lampau dengan action verb ('play'). Konteks menunjukkan perbandingan antara dulu dan sekarang.

quiz.question: When the fire broke out, Thomas Farmer and his workers ____ bread for the coming day.
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous ('were making') menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung ketika aksi lain (kebakaran) terjadi.

quiz.question: Which is the correct sentence about past habits?
options: Parents would use to sing songs to their children.
Parents didn't use to sing songs to their children.
Parents weren't use to sing songs to their children.
quiz.answer: Parents didn't use to sing songs to their children.
quiz.explanation: Bentuk negatif 'used to' adalah 'didn't use to' (tanpa 'd' di 'use'). Opsi pertama salah karena mencampur 'would' dan 'use to'.
